Test Case Title: Verify login with valid username and valid password
Preconditions: User is on the login page (https://www.saucedemo.com)
Steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com in a browser
2. Enter the username
3. Enter the password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to /inventory.html and the Products page shows 6 items.

Scenario: User can reset the app state
Test Case Title: Verify Reset App State clears the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user; 2 items in the cart
Steps:
1. Click the menu icon
2. Click 'Reset App State'
3. Check the cart badge and the product buttons
Expected Result: The cart badge is cleared. Note whether the buttons return to 'Add to cart' without a refresh.
Actual Result: The cart badge is cleared but the “add to cart” button returns only after a refresh.

Scenario: User can reset the app state
Test Case Title: Verify product buttons return to “Add to cart” after Reset App State without a page refresh
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user; 2 items in the cart
Steps:
1. Click the menu icon
2. Click 'Reset App State'
3. Look at the buttons on the Products page without refreshing
Expected Result: The buttons for the items that were in the cart return to “Add to cart”.
Actual Result: The buttons still read “Remove”. They only return to “Add to cart” after a refresh.
